assets.name: 三联镜框
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished 16:9 landscape background artwork for MIRAGE SUN THEATRE. The attached picture is a COMPOSITION AND MATERIAL REFERENCE: its straight-on opera proscenium, tangible velvet, fine gilded architecture, believable stage floor and immense real landscape depth. This is a NEW composition. Do not copy the red moon.

CRITICAL: THREE COMPLETELY SEPARATE WORLDS, seen through three FULL-SIZE OPEN STAGE BAYS. Solid opaque architectural piers, thick dark reveals and independent curtain legs separate the bays from top to bottom. Each bay opens into an actual vast living environment with substantial near terrain, middle distance and very distant horizon, perspective convergence, atmospheric depth and physically believable light. These are REAL SPACES THROUGH THE THEATRE, not projections, printed scenery, flat pictures, glass screens, mirror images or miniature model scenery. No landscape parts, water, cloud, tree, light effects or objects cross from one bay into the next. Do NOT blend worlds, superimpose them or use transparent overlapping panes. A photograph of a framed painting would look flat; this must look like a real door into a deep place.

The three universes are unmistakably different: one white-lilac GLACIAL CHASM with towering rough ice walls and a stone bridge leading toward distant frozen peaks, no city; one midnight-indigo ASTRAL OBSERVATORY HARBOUR, a substantial near stone landing and stair descending toward enormous brass orbital architecture and floating harbour terraces receding far into a planetary sky, not a painted celestial poster; one JADE MOUNTAIN FOREST with massive tactile tree roots in foreground, a winding route between deep forest cliffs, distant suspended mountains and cloud waterfalls confined to its own opening. Real-world volume, material texture, convincing horizon and strong near/far scale.

The common theatre is elegant and sumptuous, restrained classical opera architecture, fine selective champagne-gold carving, velvet with real folds, polished dark wood reflecting only nearby lights. Each world should feel large enough to walk into. The three open worlds collectively occupy at least 70 percent of the frame width and about 65 percent of the frame height; only a shallow 12–16 percent foreground stage apron, no enormous empty floor shrinking the worlds to tiny displays.

The MIRAGE SUN is an architectural LIGHTING CROWN built into the high proscenium canopy: a luminous ivory solar disk with a delicate concentric metal halo and two smaller offset parhelion optics, physically mounted to a slender stage-light bridge. A brilliant but refined warm-white sun, no red moon, no ordinary crystal chandelier. Its three discreet aimed lights illuminate the three distinct stage mouths independently; no rainbow beams crossing or blending the worlds. The solar crown remains a clear signature focal object without masking the worlds.

Premium cinematic architectural matte painting, exceptionally believable three-dimensional space and tactile fine materials, dreamlike refined light, elegant colour and a controlled hierarchy. The frame supports the worlds, not a wall of extra ornament. No people, no text, no books, no logos, no UI. No gaudy saturated rainbow effects, sparkles, floating crystals, magic particle clutter, plastic surfaces or cheap glossy game-render lighting. No isometric or top-down view. Straight-on camera at the centre of the audience, level verticals, exact frontal theatre composition.
COMPOSITION 01: A single broad opera proscenium, following the reference's deep burgundy velvet and antique gold, contains THREE majestic tall arched stage bays side by side. The central ASTRAL HARBOUR bay is 42 percent of the usable inner stage width, each flanking bay 27 percent, with two thick dark-red marble partition piers and fine gold capitals. The glacial world is on the LEFT, the astral harbour in the CENTRE, the jade forest on the RIGHT. Each bay has its own recessed midnight velvet inner curtain, and a clearly visible opaque stone sill transitioning from the shared stage into the near ground of its world. Strong independent horizons, absolutely no continuous panorama across the dividers. Warm ivory parhelion lighting crown centered over the central arch. Keep carvings concentrated at the two outer corners and the crown. Full-height large worlds, narrow elegant partitions, cinematic depth. A composition as grand as the reference but with three convincingly isolated immense realities.

COMPOSITION 02: A straight-on architectural theatre with an especially DEEP MAIN STAGE CHAMBER in the centre and two separate narrower stage chambers on either side. The central chamber occupies 46 percent of the inner stage, the flanking chambers 24 percent each, the remaining width belongs to thick ivory structural partition piers. COMPOSITION 03: An exquisite frontal pearl-ivory and muted aubergine opera theatre. THREE FULL-SIZE DISTINCT PORTAL ARCHES form an inhabited architectural arcade on the stage, each with a hefty pale carved pier and a deep black-violet reveal. The arches are almost equal in width, with the centre slightly taller. They are theatre openings into immense physical worlds, NOT windows decorated with landscape paintings. Soft gathered aubergine velvet at the far outside and between the opaque piers, thin aged champagne-gold details at the architectural junctions. LEFT: jade mountain forest with monumental roots, a near path leading into deep mist-filled mountain layers. CENTRE: white-lilac glacial abyss with an immense near stone terrace and a long bridge into distant jagged ice peaks. RIGHT: indigo astral observatory harbour, substantial near curved steps, huge orbital framework and terraces suspended at remote depths.
The stage doorways present DIFFERENT vanishing points and distant skies while remaining physically level on the same credible shared stage. The worlds never touch each other. The sunlight system takes the form of a luminous ivory parhelion sun and two subtle companion optics embedded within the upper curved cornice, a single deliberate signature rather than multiple unrelated glowing ornaments. Theatrical floor only a narrow dark-plum foreground with elegant shallow steps and a few small warm footlights. Refined formal rhythm, spatial clarity, authentic materials and extraordinary depth, sumptuous yet edited, bright worlds framed by quiet dark reveals.
